purpose: VALUES on which two references' headers of ONE pair disagree, DECIDED: which header is the pair's authority, with both values recorded. The census's values step reads an entry as `decided` only while BOTH recorded values still hold; a value that moved, on either side, fails the step and names the entry, so the decision is read again. This is data, never a skip: a name this table does not hold whose two values differ is a MISMATCH and fails the step. One entry per (format, dialect, header, name) -- the object format of the leg's pair, the dialect of the reference that disagrees (clang, gcc or msvc, as prototype-census.py reads it from the compiler), the header and the name.
